evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan concurrency and internal locking across src/wallet/.
rationale: Converts DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan's mutex from RecursiveMutex to a standard non-recursive Mutex to clarify lock hierarchies and eliminate re-entrancy deadlock risks with synchronous notification listeners. As an internal concurrency refactoring contributing to #19303 with no intended changes to wallet database format, RPC, or keypool semantics, it provides sound architectural stability without urgent release-critical pressure.
